why: A-37 established that saveState/loadState cannot carry the assistance audit. The proposed replacement is replay by RE-EXECUTION, which rests on an assumption of its own. This package tests it.

questions.Q1: two fresh starts, same seed, same commands: identical trajectories?
questions.Q2: two fresh starts identical up to decision k and different after: are the frames BEFORE k exactly equal?
questions.Q3: control: do the arms actually differ after k, so that Q2 is not vacuous?

acceptance_rule.REPRODUCIBLE_AND_PREFIX_COUPLED: A1 == A2 in full, and B's prefix == A1's prefix
acceptance_rule.REPRODUCIBLE_PREFIX_NOT_COUPLED: A1 == A2 but B's prefix differs
acceptance_rule.PROCESS_FAILED: SUMO could not be started or did not terminate cleanly

diagnostic_arm_declared_in_advance: if Q1 fails under SUMO defaults, one further pair with sigma = 0 may run; no other arm without a recorded deviation
